subTitle: Digital space helps with Work and Relaxation
desc: Chill Daily is a multifunctional personal app designed to create a peaceful, focused, and productive experience. With a clean interface and thoughtfully crafted features, it helps you stay organized, centered, and inspired throughout your day.
focusMode: 💻 Focus mode - Optimize space to help you focus absolutely.
changeWallpaper: 🖼️ Change wallpaper – Personalize your workspace with calming images to suit your mood.
watchYoutube: 📺 Watch YouTube videos – Watch videos for learning or relaxation without switching tabs.
Note: 📝 Take notes & compose – Capture ideas and write notes with a powerful text editor.
taskly: ✅ Task management – ​Plan, track, and complete your to-dos with ease.
timer: ⏱️ Smart timer – Boost productivity using Pomodoro or countdown techniques.
bgMusic: 🎵 Background music – Set the mood with relaxing background music while you work.
weather: 🌦️ View the weather - Always be aware of current weather conditions and forecasts, helping you plan effectively.
footer: ✨ Make each day a perfectly chill journey. ✨
